'''Kurt Schlichting The Bith Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Kurt Schlichting]]
* '''Published:''' April 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Hoth]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Tatooine: Dune Sea]]
* '''Strategy:''' The Bith Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PHoth The Bith Deck Schlichting LS 1997.txt |Download]]
